body: 21:45-22:07: owner decisions applied, shell finished, wave 2 launched, wave 1 shipping.U+000AU+000AOwner answers (decisions 01M3ZXYD3M8K0R94MH5CDX1M80, 01M3ZXYJ6ND002HDJ93AP0FG54, 01M3ZXYPBG939YWKB61QPBT82M, 01M3ZXYTAKP3EA4AYPHSNGX6Q6):U+000AU+002D Gear: keep 44 and accept it.U+000AU+002D Notification icon: fix it in this run.U+000AU+002D Calendar contrast: darker ink.U+000AU+002D Criterion 1: count exit 6 from unwritten paths as met. Criteria 1 and 2 are reworded, and criterion 1 is marked done.U+000AU+000AShell branch mitosis/proto-phone-shell, fast-forwarded in the wave 1 run worktree to 19d9386f with 8 fix-up commits on top of 14a166b3:U+000AU+002D d8a9af23, 4675970c, ac886d9c, 46a892d2, d4296f82, 758fa029 (as logged earlier).U+000AU+002D b054b331 test(shell): accept the 44-point phone header gear in the accessibility sweep. fixes_recorded_test `_accepted` takes small-target 'Settings' only for states a1-today-empty and a8-garden-phone, and shell.txt gained exactly those two lines.U+000AU+002D 19d9386f fix(calendar): darker light-theme ink. The new top-level `phoneCalendarSmallAccentInk(context)` in phone_flower_month.dart gives coralHover #9A4832 in light theme and accentInk in dark. It is used by the This month pill (text and chevron) and MonthYearBackButton. The new test test/features/calendar/phone_calendar_contrast_test.dart applies textContrastGuideline to the month and the month sheet. It was red at 2.98:1 and is green now.U+000AU+002D Also found but out of scope: in light theme, inside BottomBarShell, the header 'field notes' wordmark measures 2.93:1 (needs 3.0 at 23 pt) and the 11-point tab label 'Today' 3.95:1. These are prototype colours from Lane 2. Not raised as a decision yet; tell the owner.U+000AU+002D Full suite at 19d9386f: analyze clean; all 4,217 tests pass across every folder, including test/widget_test.dart; the Meadow goldens ran in America/Edmonton; test/impeller passes with --enable-impeller; no skips. Written to ~/.mitosis/field-notes/prototype-phone-macos/suite-proto-phone-shell.txt.U+000AU+000AApp-icon branch mitosis/proto-app-icon: 4fab7de6 feat(app): white peony notification icon for Android reminders.U+000AU+002D tool/icons/render_app_icons.dart renders ic_stat_peony.png at mdpi 24, hdpi 36, xhdpi 48, xxhdpi 72 and xxxhdpi 96. It paints each flower shape white, then clears its outline stroke, so the petal gaps survive. It also writes res/raw/keep.xml with tools:keep="@drawable/ic_stat_peony", because Flutter release builds shrink resources and the icon is named only from Dart.U+000AU+002D The scheduler exposes `reminderNotificationIcon = '@drawable/ic_stat_peony'`, used by AndroidInitializationSettings.U+000AU+002D New tests: test/tooling/notification_icon_test.dart (white on transparent, coverage between 20 and 70 percent, at least 8 percent gaps inside the bounding box, keep.xml) and a scheduler test that the Android defaultIcon is the peony. All three were red first.U+000AU+002D A dark-background preview is at ~/.mitosis/field-notes/prototype-phone-macos/previews/proto-app-icon/ic_stat_peony_preview.png.U+000AU+002D Full suite at 4fab7de6: analyze clean, all 4,107 tests pass. Written to suite-proto-app-icon.txt.U+000AU+000AWave 2: plan-only reported 16 Steps in 8 Lanes and 3 MSPs (meadow is one 6-Step Lane), plan id 03962ebda107. Launched detached at 21:56 (pid in wave2.pid, log wave2.log); Lanes 0 (meadow) and 1 (onboarding-roots) started first.U+000AU+000AWave 1 ship: pr_adapter.py gained per-MSP 'more' (extra --what bullets), 'checks' (extra --verified lines) and 'risk' (--risk), with every value capped at 500 characters. The shell PR gets four plain-language follow-up bullets, three checks and the gear risk; the app-icon PR gets the notification-icon bullet, a check and a device not-verified line. The pre-edit copy is in the scratchpad as pr_adapter.before.py. `SHIP=1 run.zsh 1 --resume` was launched detached at 22:07 (pid in wave1-ship.pid, log wave1-ship.log). It re-gates both MSPs at their current tips, which include the fix-ups, reconciles, pushes and opens draft PRs against main through pr.mjs. Reconcile will list the fix-up files as undeclared; the PR bullets describe them. Watch: Monitor bucvpcyha.
